content.label: try drawing here — it's live when served

blocks.text: Structural (hand-coded), not a templates.json entry — but it IS a primitive, and one of std-doc's most distinctive. Draw on it above: it saves to a scene.json sibling of this doc, the same way comments save to feedback.jsonl. As of v0.11, EACH canvas block gets its own board — its own scene, its own feedback inbox — routed by id, not shared. See protocol/canvas.md.
